body: M5 (Mike's pools) is taking this overnight, because the maintainer's bug lanes are full (#2382, #2380). The worker posts its own claim when it starts. If you want it back, comment here and M5 releases it at once.

claimed: Antigravity (len) · 2026-11-17 23:36 UTC · branch mkinney:issue/2403-friendly-pick-names · plan: add Revision-cached per-body FeatureNames lookup table in geometry+app (no hex ids in Display or UI/refusals/MCP) and route every UI page, status line, refusal, and MCP pick view through it.

Audit of every place in `crates/app` and `crates/ui` that currently formats a picked item for the user:

### `crates/app`
- `crates/app/src/operation/types/sel.rs:68-77` — `impl Display for FeatureSel` (`"face {id:#x}"`, `"edge chain {id:#x}"`, `"welded face {id:#x}"`, `"vertex {id:#x}"`)
- `crates/app/src/pick/roles.rs:120,127,181,186-189,209-216` — WCS role alignment refusals formatting `"{} of '{}'"`
- `crates/app/src/pick/align.rs:160,180,189,216,227,232,239,246` — 3-2-1 alignment refusals formatting `"{} of '{}'"`
- `crates/app/src/pick/plane.rs:144-155,171,174,189,203` — Setup plane alignment refusals and `plane_side` formatting `g.feature` / `g.entity`
- `crates/app/src/pick/points.rs:115` — Setup 3-points alignment refusal formatting `"{} of '{}'"`
- `crates/app/src/pick/axis.rs:274,282,318` — Setup Part-axes alignment refusals formatting `"{} of '{}'"`
- `crates/app/src/pick/mate.rs:57,64,68,71,73,78,83,86` — Stock/Fixture mate datum refusals formatting `"{} of '{}'"`
- `crates/app/src/pick/circle.rs:155,157` — `CircleRefusal` messages formatting `"{} of '{}'"`
- `crates/app/src/pick/feature_sel.rs:107-117` — `check_pickable` refusals formatting `"{} of '{}'"`
- `crates/app/src/fixture_locate.rs:118,122` — Fixture/Part locate refusals formatting `"{} of '{}'"`
- `crates/app/src/commands/operation/geometry.rs:115` — `valid_pick` refusal (`"{} of '{}' is not in the model"`)
- `crates/app/src/operation/selection.rs:127,293` — `drive_chains` & `selection_geometry_in` labels (`format!("{} of '{}'", g.feature, g.entity)`)
- `crates/app/src/operation/boundary_picks.rs:326` — missing boundary pick refusal (`"{} is no longer in the model - re-pick it"`)
- `crates/app/src/operation/sinker_faces.rs:58` — `PickedFace::label` (`format!("{} of '{}'", g.feature, g.entity)`)
- `crates/app/src/mcp/pick.rs:91-93,104,113` — `picks_view` JSON (`id` without friendly `name`) and `kind_door` refusals formatting `"{} of '{}'"`
- `crates/app/src/mcp/features.rs` — `list_features` JSON entries (ids without friendly `name`)
- `crates/app/src/mcp/wcs_tools.rs:119-122` — `set_wcs_from_features` returned `picks` JSON (ids without friendly `name`)
- `crates/app/src/mcp/pockets.rs:40` — `pocket_view` returned `"floor"` id without `"floor_name"`

### `crates/ui`
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_pick_row.rs:80-86` — WCS page "Set WCS from features" picked list (`"{} of '{}' sets {}"`)
- `crates/ui/src/wcs_pick.rs:83-93` — WCS feature pick status line (`"{} of '{}' picked as {}"`)
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_plane_pick.rs:103-105` — Setup Plane "Picked:" row (`"{} of '{}'"`)
- `crates/ui/src/plane_pick.rs:64-80` — Setup Plane pick status line (`"{} of '{}' is ..."`)
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_points_pick.rs:100-109` — Setup 3-points "Point N:" rows (`"{} of '{}'"`)
- `crates/ui/src/points_pick.rs:60-80` — Setup 3-points pick status line (`"{} of '{}'"`)
- `crates/ui/src/axis_pick.rs:210-281` — Setup Part-axes pick status line and `picks_text` axis rows
- `crates/ui/src/locate_pick.rs:79-96` — Stock/Fixture Locate `describe` row formatting datum or fallback `"{} of '{}'"`
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs:892-895,2362-2601` — `short_id` hex fallback and `State::geo_chips` Geometry tab chip labels (`Face ...`, `Chain ...`, `Welded face ...`, `Vertex ...`)
- `crates/ui/src/interact.rs:236,241` — viewport selection status line (`"{} of '{}' is already selected"` / `"added to {}"`)
- `crates/ui/src/edge_pick.rs:53,98` — operation chain removal and closed-loop status lines formatting `"{} of '{}'"`
- `crates/ui/src/boundary_draft.rs:371,387` — boundary draft status lines formatting `"{} of '{}'"`
- `crates/ui/src/feature_click.rs:199` — boundary vertex refusal status line formatting `"{} of '{}'"`

Held work pushed to `mkinney:issue/2403-friendly-pick-names` (`c28ae6f95` on `upstream/main` `abe24ff09`). Stopping per Step 7 after `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` failed twice on an unrelated baseline timing test (`app suites: shoulder_adaptive`).

What was built and verified on `mkinney:issue/2403-friendly-pick-names`:
- Deterministic `FeatureNames` (`crates/geometry/src/geometry/feature/names.rs` + `patch_shape.rs`): maps planar/free faces (`Face N`), bores (`Bore N`), convex cylinders (`Cylinder N`), general curved patches (`Curved face N`), chains/runs/singleton edges (`Edge N`), and vertices (`Vertex N`).
- Shared ECS memo `FeatureNamesMemo` (`crates/app/src/schema.rs`, `crates/app/src/pick/names.rs`) keyed by `Revision` + live `Weak<[Triangle]>`.
- Updated `FeatureSel::Display`, `crates/app` pick/refusal/fixture/operation formatters, all MCP feature/pick views (`"name"` beside `"id"`), and all `crates/ui` status/row/chip formatters; recorded decision in `docs/decisions/2403-friendly-pick-names.md`.
- Pins and mutation checks passed:
  - `camcraft-geometry --lib feature::names` (`2 passed; 0 failed`)
  - `camcraft-app --lib pick::names` (`feature_names_cache_once_per_revision_for_model_and_stock`: `1 passed; 0 failed`)
  - `camcraft-app --test mcp_pick` (`mcp_and_app_refusals_use_shared_friendly_pick_names_without_hex`: `8 passed; 0 failed`), `--test mcp_live` (`14 passed`), `--test fixture_locate_stock_cylinder` (`3 passed`), `--test winding_align` (`9 passed`)
  - `camcraft-ui --lib` (`1066 passed; 0 failed; 7 ignored` including `picked_items_never_show_hex_ids_and_keep_one_name_across_pages`), `--test operations` (`31 passed`), `--test boundary/boundary_picks/egui_app/feedback/fixtures/machine/models/shell` (all passed)
  - `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` (clean), `cargo test -p xtask` (`154+4+3+1+3 passed`), `0` golden `.nc`/`.cl` files changed
  - Three mutation checks (reverted `FeatureSel::Display`, `crates/ui/src/state.rs`, and `FeatureNamesMemo` cache hit check) failed before restore and passed after restore.

Why the gate stopped:
- Touching `crates/geometry/src/geometry/feature.rs` makes `gate quick` fall back to `batch` (`843` steps):
  - `--only debug --only geometry --only kernel --only cl --only tools --only post --only sim`: `204/204` passed (`17.0 min`).
  - `--only ui --only clippy`: `23/23` passed (`1.5 min`, after `trace_parity` passed in `1s` on re-run following a one-off SIGSEGV).
  - `--only app`: `522/523` passed; ONLY `shoulder_adaptive` failed (`containment_outside_clears_past_the_edge_never_the_recess` at `crates/app/tests/shoulder_adaptive.rs:88`: `t0.elapsed().as_secs_f64() < 60.0` — `67.75s` in batch, `103s` on isolated retry, `132.90s` single test).
  - Tested clean unmodified `upstream/main` `abe24ff09` (`git stash`) on `containment_outside_clears_past_the_edge_never_the_recess` alone: it ALSO failed identically in `91.93s` (`the band plans in seconds, not minutes`). Note `motion` suite (`93` steps) was not re-run in full after `abe24ff09`, though `adaptive_entry_pieces::a_narrow_second_piece_names_its_ramp_stand_in_at_each_level` passed in `0.00s`; newer `upstream/main` `c0c92ee86` is currently red per `#2451`.

Note for the next worker: the Antigravity run on len (stopped 05:35 UTC) failed its quick gate twice on an UNRELATED baseline test, `app::shoulder_adaptive::containment_outside_clears_past_the_edge_never_the_recess` (over 60 s in debug on that host). That is not this issue's work - see the new issue for the slow test. Run this issue's own pinning tests and gate-mapped suites; if that baseline test is the only failure, say so in the PR body and go on.
